metadata.description: Complete list of all Chicago 311 service request types with descriptions

request_types.name: Abandoned Vehicle Complaint
request_types.description: Use this service request to report an abandoned vehicle. (Car, truck, motorcycle, etc.)

request_types.name: Accessible Home Modifications - Disabilities
request_types.description: This service request is used when requesting assistance to modify homes for accessibility. A typical request would include lifts, ramps, kitchens, bathrooms for accessibility. We service people with disabilities and seniors.

request_types.name: Accessible Pedestrian Signal Complaint
request_types.description: Report maintenance issues with an EXISTING Accessible Pedestrian Signal. Accessible Pedestrian Signals (APS) are devices that use audible and/or vibrotactile cues to communicate pedestrian signal information to individuals with visual impairments, ensuring they can safely cross streets. Attention: If you are requesting a NEW Accessible Pedestrian Signal (APS), please use service request type: New Accessible Pedestrian Signal Request.

request_types.name: Air Pollution, Odor or Dust Complaint
request_types.description: Use this service request type to report dust, odors or other air pollution from commercial and industrial sites. This service request does not apply to privately owned barbecues and fireplaces.

request_types.name: Aircraft Noise Complaint
request_types.description: Use this service request to report an airport or aircraft-related noise issue. Please note: in order to include your aircraft noise complaint in the Airport Noise Management System report, you must provide a verifiable Illinois address when completing your contact information for this request.

request_types.name: Alley Light Out Complaint
request_types.description: Report an alley light out (located on a wooden pole). To report street lights that are not working, use Street Light Out.

request_types.name: Alley Pothole Complaint
request_types.description: Report alley potholes. To report a utility cut (usually a square cut made for utility repairs) or a sinkhole (a deep dip or void in the pavement) call 311 directly.

request_types.name: Alley Sewer Inspection Request
request_types.description: Use this service request to report problems with alley sewers, such as a caved-in sewer, a hole close to the sewer or standing water because the sewer is clogged. This service request can also be used to report persons illegally dumping something into an alley sewer. If you are viewing the dumping in progress, call 911 with the license plate number and a description of the vehicle and/or individuals involved. If you are reporting the problem after the fact, please include a name, address or other information.

request_types.name: Animal In Trap Complaint
request_types.description: Use this service request to report an animal in a trap. Do not use if the animal is loose inside a house or building. Do not use this service request to report animals confined in boxes or carriers – use Stray Animal call type instead. If the animal is in a private trap CACC will not pick it up. Callers without a valid state issued permit will have the trap confiscated (i.e., not returned) & may be referred to the state for illegal trapping for possible fines.

request_types.name: Asbestos Complaint
request_types.description: Use this service request to report any asbestos-related complaints.

request_types.name: Benefit Access Assistance - Disabilities
request_types.description: This service request should be used to request assistance while applying, reapplying, or checking on a Benefit Access Application. This program is only available to people 59 years of age and under.

request_types.name: Bicycle Request/Complaint
request_types.description: Use this service request to report abandoned PERSONAL bikes (For Divvy or 'Lyft' branded bikeshare bikes, instead, use service request 'Divvy Bike Parking Complaint'). If you are requesting a new bike rack you can also visit this link: https://bikeparking-chicago.hub.arcgis.com/ Bicycle Request Complaint can also be used to report damage to bike racks, to request a new bike lane, bike program literature, or to report CONSTRUCTION blocking bike lanes. NOTE: FOR VEHICLES PARKED OR BLOCKING BIKE LANES USE SERVICE REQUEST 'FINANCE PARKING CODE ENFORCEMENT REVIEW' AS THE DEPARTMENT OF FINANCE HAS PARKING ENFORCEMENT AUTHORITY OR USE THIS LINK: https://311.chicago.gov/s/new-service-request?typecodeid=a1P8z00000JNgKuEAL&language=en_US

request_types.name: Blue Recycling Cart
request_types.description: Use this service request when a recycling container has been damaged or stolen and a replacement is needed. Note: This service request is for residents who are eligible for collection services with the Department of Streets & Sanitation, for more information go here: www.chicagorecycles.org

request_types.name: Building Violation
request_types.description: This service request is used to report general building code violations. Complaints include missing or broken windows/screens, illegal apartments, falling bricks/terra-cotta from the exterior, peeling paint or holes, falling plaster from walls/ceilings and buildings with multiple building code violations.

request_types.name: Buildings - Boiler Violation
request_types.description: This service request is used for comments and complaints about boilers in all residential buildings.

request_types.name: Buildings - Electrical Violation
request_types.description: This service request is used for comments and complaints regarding defective and dangerous electrical wiring systems in all types of buildings and occupancies throughout the city.

request_types.name: Buildings - Elevator Violation
request_types.description: This service request is used for comments and complaints regarding all types of elevators (both passenger and freight), escalators and other similar people movers.

request_types.name: Bungalow/Vintage Home Information Request
request_types.description: This service request is used to request the mailing of information on technical assistance to current and would-be owners of Historic Chicago Bungalows and Vintage Homes. Information will be sent to you that can guide you in the purchase, restoration, or modernization of these homes, and help you find the resources you need.

request_types.name: Business Complaints
request_types.description: Use this service request to report an individual or business operating without a proper City of Chicago business license, or to report complaints against liquor license holders, including sale of alcohol to minors and case payouts on poker or other gambling machines

request_types.name: Cable TV Complaint
request_types.description: This service request is used to report billing, service or any other problems with cable television companies that operate under the City of Chicago cable franchise agreement.

request_types.name: City Clerk Feedback Request
request_types.description: This code will be used to submit general feedback and ideas to the Office of the City Clerk regarding any topic except City Vehicle Sticker Violation, Please use City Vehicle Sticker Violation for those request.

request_types.name: City Vehicle Sticker Violation
request_types.description: This service request is used to report vehicles that are registered to a Chicago address that are not displaying the City of Chicago Vehicle License on the windshield.

request_types.name: Clean and Green Program Request
request_types.description: This service request is used to request supplies for neighborhood clean-up activities. Tools are loaned to community groups throughout the year. Requests for tools must be received 3-4 business days prior to date of clean up. Tools and bags will be picked up at the local Streets & Sanitation Division. Groups wishing to have a weekend clean-up must pick up the supplies on Friday. (Tools may be picked up on Saturday only on the special citywide Clean and Green days.)

request_types.name: Clean Vacant Lot Request
request_types.description: This service request is used to report litter, trash or debris on vacant lots. If your request is regarding excessive debris or illegal dumping, please use the "Fly Dumping Complaint" instead. If your request is for Weed Removal, please call 311 to submit a "Weed Removal Request" instead.

request_types.name: Commercial Fire Safety Inspection Request
request_types.description: This service request is used to ask the Fire Department to schedule an inspection to determine whether fire hazards exist in a commercial property. If a residential inspection is needed enter a building violation instead.

request_types.name: Construction & Demolition Complaint
request_types.description: Use this service request to report issues with construction or demolition sites. To report dust, odors or other air pollution from construction sites use the Air Pollution, Odor or Dust Complaint. If the complaint is related to noise and the work is occurring between 8PM and 8AM, please refer to the Chicago Police Department.

request_types.name: Consumer Fraud Complaint
request_types.description: Use this service request to report unscrupulous or possibly illegal practices by a business (i.e., Defective Merchandise; Paid for a service such as home repair that was not completed; Deceptive Immigration Service Tactics; Failure to Honor a Warranty; Unauthorized Charges added to purchase price, etc.).

request_types.name: Consumer Retail Business Complaint
request_types.description: Use this service request to report complaints against retail businesses in the City of Chicago (i.e., Refund Violation, Foodware Violation, Overcharged, False Advertisement, Outdated Merchandise).

request_types.name: Coyote Interaction Complaint
request_types.description: Use this service request to report coyote interaction. Sightings from a distance should not be reported as coyotes are state-protected wildlife.

request_types.name: Discrimination Assistance Request
request_types.description: Use this service request to enter requests related to discrimination within the City of Chicago in employment, housing, public accommodations, credit and bonding, sexual harassment, which are prohibited under the Chicago Human Rights and Fair Housing Ordinances; for hate crimes, community tensions, and requests for human relations educational workshops and presentations.

request_types.name: Divvy Bike Parking Complaint
request_types.description: Used to report improperly parked Divvy bike or "Lyft" branded bikeshare bike, so it can be retrieved and/or corrected by the Divvy Operator.

request_types.name: E-Scooter Parking Complaint
request_types.description: Report an electric scooter (e-scooter) blocking the public way after a rider has finished their ride. Residents can provide information on the e-scooter location and company, so it can be retrieved and or corrected by the Operator. Customer service issues (such as account questions) should be directed to the appropriate e-scooter company. Divvy/Lyft: divvybikes.com/contact or 1-855-553-4889 Lime: https://www.li.me/ or support@li.me or 1-888-546-3345.

request_types.name: Finance Parking Code Enforcement Review
request_types.description: Report a vehicle due to parking issue(s). This information will be used for analysis to target problem locations. FPCE - used to map target problem locations.

request_types.name: Fly Dumping Complaint
request_types.description: This service request is used to report garbage or construction debris that has been illegally dumped on the public way or on a vacant lot. If you are viewing the dumping in progress, call 911 with the license plate number and a description of the vehicle and/or individuals involved. If you are reporting the problem after the fact, please include the license plate number and a description of the vehicle and/or individuals involved on this service request.

request_types.name: Gas Station and Storage Tank Complaint
request_types.description: Use this service request to report issues related to under-ground storage tanks and above-ground storage tanks, pump malfunctions, odors, and fuel spills. Any concerns regarding receipts or customer service at a gas station should be referred to BACP.

request_types.name: Graffiti Removal Request
request_types.description: Use this request to report graffiti that is on your property, public property or on someone else's property. Graffiti will be removed from public or private property by Graffiti Program. Graffiti will either be painted over (if the graffiti is on a painted surface) or blasted off with a high pressure baking soda and water solution (if it is on brick, cement or stone).

request_types.name: Housing Information - Disabilities
request_types.description: This service request should be used when requesting housing information for a person with a disability. This program is only available to people 59 years of age and under. The Mayor's Office for People with Disabilities does not provide housing.

request_types.name: In-Home Services – Disabilities
request_types.description: This service request should be used to request a homemaker, home delivered meals, or other assistance in the home for a person with a disability. This program is only available to people 59 years of age and under.

request_types.name: Inaccurate Fuel Pump Complaint
request_types.description: Use this service request to report complaints about inaccurate/inappropriate charges for fuel, pumps dispensing contaminated fuel, and other fuel pump issues in the City of Chicago (i.e., Leaking nozzle or hose; Price counter continues to run after fuel stops dispensing, etc.).

request_types.name: Inaccurate Retail Scales Complaint
request_types.description: Use this service request to report problems with behind-the-counter scales used by retail businesses in the City of Chicago (i.e., scales used to weigh produce or deli items; scales used by private shipping services such as FedEx, UPS, and USPS). It does not include hanging scales used by consumers.

request_types.name: Landlord/Tenant Info Request
request_types.description: This service request is used to request literature regarding the City's Residential Landlord & Tenant Ordinance. Landlords and tenants may also wish to call (312) 742-7368, the Chicago Rents Right hotline. Tenants may also call (773) 292-4988 to seek assistance from the Metropolitan Tenants Organization, which provides service on behalf of our Department of Housing.

request_types.name: Lead Inspection Request
request_types.description: This service request is used to request an inspection of a building for lead paint or other lead hazards, especially when small children live in the dwelling. PLEASE NOTE: This code should not be used for a Water Lead Test Kit Request or Water Lead Test Visit Request.

request_types.name: Low Water Pressure Complaint
request_types.description: Use this service request to report low water pressure inside a building that you own. Please contact your landlord if there is a problem in a space that you are renting.

request_types.name: Missed Garbage Pick-Up Complaint
request_types.description: Use this service request to report the city truck that regularly picks up your garbage has not done so. Let us know if only your garbage pickup was missed, or if the entire alley was missed. If you do not know your garbage pickup schedule, then you may call 311 for information. The Department of Streets and Sanitation, Bureau of Sanitation is responsible for this service.

request_types.name: Mosquito Spraying Inquiries (Formerly West Nile Virus)
request_types.description: Code is used to report comments and concerns regarding the West Nile Virus. CDPH only sprays on trap data test results not based on citizen request.

request_types.name: New Accessible Pedestrian Signal Request
request_types.description: Request for NEW Accessible Pedestrian Signal. Accessible Pedestrian Signals (APS) are devices that use audible and/or vibrotactile cues to communicate pedestrian signal information to individuals with visual impairments, ensuring they can safely cross streets. Attention: If you are requesting maintenance of an EXISTING Accessible Pedestrian Signal, please use service request type: Accessible Pedestrian Signal Complaint. For APS devices that are eligible to be installed, please visit website chicagoaps.org to track installation.

request_types.name: No Building Permit and Construction Violation
request_types.description: Use this service request to report persons or companies building or rehabilitating a structure without having a City Building Permit displayed. The permit is to be posted where it's visible from the public way.

request_types.name: No Heat Complaint
request_types.description: Use this service request to report landlords who are not providing sufficient heat to tenants of residential dwelling units. You must provide certain information to initiate an inspection of the property.

request_types.name: No Solicitation Complaint
request_types.description: Use this service request to report a person or business distributing commercial advertising matter (e.g., coupons, menus, sales announcements, general advertisements) on private property.

request_types.name: Equipment Noise Complaint
request_types.description: Use this service request report excessive noise coming from air conditioners, compressors, generators, or any other piece of industrial or commercial equipment. If the noise occurs between the hours of 8PM and 8AM, please call 311. If your complaint is regarding street musicians, bar noise, or loud music please refer to the Chicago Police Department.

request_types.name: Noise Complaint - Garbage Truck (Private Vendor)
request_types.description: Use this code to report a (private) garbage truck that is collecting garbage prior to 7:00 AM. Garbage collection is allowed during the hours of 7:00 AM and 10:00 PM.

request_types.name: Open Fire Hydrant Complaint
request_types.description: This service request is used to report illegally opened fire hydrants with water coming out of the nozzle.

request_types.name: Outdated Merchandise Complaint
request_types.description: Use this service request to report food or over-the-counter medication being sold after the sell-by date by retail businesses in the City of Chicago. Food and medication that has not expired, but the consumer believes to be unsafe, should be reported to the Chicago Department of Public Health.

request_types.name: Paid Sick Leave Violation
request_types.description: Use this service request to enter complaints regarding Paid Sick Leave Ordinance and Anti-Retaliation (COVID-19) violations from any employee who works at least 2 hours within a 2 week period within the City of Chicago, and is at least 18 years old.

request_types.name: Pet Wellness Check Request
request_types.description: Use this service request to report the need of a wellness check, an animal being beaten or abused, or concerns for a pet such as no food, no water, unsanitary pet conditions, etc.

request_types.name: Petcoke Dust Complaint
request_types.description: Petroleum coke, or "petcoke," is a solid carbon material that resembles coal. Facilities that store and handle this material are required to take measures to prevent the offsite dispersion of dust. In order to ensure that the facilities are complying with the law, the City is asking residents near these facilities to report any observations of dust coming from these sites.

request_types.name: Porch Inspection Request
request_types.description: This service request is used to report a porch that may be dangerous due to rot, damage, poor construction or any other conditions that may render it unsafe.

request_types.name: Pothole in Street Complaint
request_types.description: Report locations of street potholes. Use Alley Pot Hole to report potholes in alleys.

request_types.name: Public Vehicle/Valet Complaint
request_types.description: This service request is used to report complaints against any Charter Bus/Trolley, Horse-Drawn Carriage, Limousine Service, Pedicab, or Valet Parking Service.

request_types.name: Pushcart Food Vendor Complaint
request_types.description: This service request is used to report health or sanitary problems with pushcart food vendors.

request_types.name: Recycling Inspection Request
request_types.description: Use this service request type to requests an inspection for compliance. Landlords, management companies and businesses who want more information on compliance can call (312)744-2413.

request_types.name: Recycling Pick Up
request_types.description: Use this service request for requesting a missed recycling pick-up. Note: Prior to submitting your request, please confirm your collection day by visiting this link: www.chicagorecycles.org

request_types.name: Renters and Foreclosure Complaint
request_types.description: Use this service request to report if the property you live in was foreclosed and you did not receive proper notice regarding the option of renewing your lease or receiving relocation assistance (e.g., building is foreclosed and you are being forced out without any options).

request_types.name: Restaurant Complaint
request_types.description: This service request is used to report problems related to food safety at restaurants. Do not use this type to report problems relating to pricing, weights, expiration dates, or other business issues. These complaints are to be entered as Consumer Retail Store Complaint.

request_types.name: Ridesharing Complaint
request_types.description: This service request is used to report complaints against Uber, Lyft, Via or other ride-share companies.

request_types.name: Rodent Baiting/Rat Complaint
request_types.description: Use this service request to report a rodent or rat problem.

request_types.name: Sanitation Code Violation
request_types.description: Use this service type to report unsanitary conditions on private property that should cause the owner to be cited for violating the City's sanitation codes. Certain questions must be answered to initiate an investigation: the location address and what type of problem exists. It is helpful to know who is responsible for the problem, if known. If you can leave your name and phone number, the inspectors sometimes need to contact the complainant in order to issue a citation to the violator.

request_types.name: Senior Information and Assistance Request
request_types.description: This service request is used to request information and assistance from FSS-Senior Services. If a Senior needs the immediate assistance of Police, Fire or Emergency Medical services, please call 911.

request_types.name: Senior Related Literature Request
request_types.description: This service request is used to have brochures and/or literature sent out for senior citizen-related programs and services.

request_types.name: Senior Well-Being Check Request
request_types.description: This service request is used to identify seniors whose health, safety or general well being are in question. The City will send a team of Human Services specialists to make a assessment of the client's needs. Follow-up services can be identified and provided as needed.

request_types.name: Sewer Cave-In Inspection Request
request_types.description: This service request is to be used for the following reasons: cave-in by the sewer, sewer cave-in in the street.

request_types.name: Sewer Cleaning Inspection Request
request_types.description: This service request is used to request that the City sewers, located on or near the curb, be checked for cleaning. Certain questions must be answered to create a work order for an inspection: the address location, whether this sewer is in front of your home and the location of the sewer (street, curb line, alley etc.). Do not use this service type to request cleaning of a catch basin on private property. That is the property owner's responsibility.

request_types.name: Shared Housing/Vacation Rental Complaint
request_types.description: Use this service request to report issues regarding vacation rental properties (e.g., VRBO (Vacation Rental by Owner)), Shared Housing (i.e., AirBNB) and Bed and Breakfasts. Complaint examples include, but are not limited to the following: service not provided, poor condition of property, excessive noise, etc.

request_types.name: Sidewalk Café/Outdoor Dining Complaint
request_types.description: Use this service request to report complaints against a restaurant's sidewalk café or outdoor dining area (i.e., not enough space for pedestrians to walk by; obstruction of sidewalk, etc.)

request_types.name: Sidewalk Inspection Request
request_types.description: Use this service request to report the condition of City sidewalks or accessibility (ADA) ramp issues. If you are requesting sidewalk repair, please continue. The city will complete a sidewalk condition survey.

request_types.name: Sign Repair Request - All Other Signs
request_types.description: Report maintenance issues to miscellaneous missing, damaged or graffitied signs such as bike route, disabled parking, street name, and loading zone, parking restriction, pedestrian crossing, or speed limit signs. Please note "Do Not Enter", "One-Way", and "Stop" signs have their own service request types. Requests to have new signs installed (meaning the sign has never existed at the location before) must be made directly to the alderman's office.

request_types.name: Sign Repair - Base / Bolt Removal
request_types.description: Report empty sign bases or bolts sticking up from the sidewalk that need to be removed.

request_types.name: Sign Repair Request - Do Not Enter Sign
request_types.description: Report maintenance issues to damaged or missing "Do Not Enter" signs.

request_types.name: Sign Repair Request - One Way Sign
request_types.description: Report maintenance issues to damaged or missing "One Way" signs.

request_types.name: Sign Repair Request - Stop Sign
request_types.description: Used to report damaged or missing "Stop" Signs. ATTENTION: If street pavement markings at stop signs are faded or missing, create service request to: STREET PAINT MARKING MAINTENANCE.

request_types.name: Smokeless Tobacco at Sports Event Complaint
request_types.description: Use this Service Request Type to report violations of the No Smokeless Tobacco Use Ordinance passed by the Chicago City Council to protect the health of patrons and workers against the known dangers of smokeless tobacco. A photo or video is required to follow up on complaints of individuals using smokeless tobacco at sports venues.

request_types.name: Street Cleaning Request
request_types.description: This service request is used for curb to curb sweeping the debris off the street by a street sweeping machine (mechanical sweeper).

request_types.name: Street Light On During Day Complaint
request_types.description: Report street lights that are on during the day.

request_types.name: Street Light Out Complaint
request_types.description: Report a street light outage on a residential or arterial street (street lights are located on metal poles).

request_types.name: Street Light Pole Damage Complaint
request_types.description: Report a street light pole that has been severely damaged and/or knocked down or to report a stray voltage/shock issue (use description field to enter details for stray voltage/shock issue). To report traffic signal pole down, use Traffic Signal Out. To report street or traffic pole access doors that are missing, use Street Light Pole Door Missing.

request_types.name: Street Light Pole Door Missing Complaint
request_types.description: Report a missing cover plate at the base of a street light or traffic signal pole.

request_types.name: Tanning and Body Art Complaint
request_types.description: Use this Service Request type to report complaints related to the use of tanning equipment, receipt of a tattoo or other body art procedure including body piercing and permanent make up.

request_types.name: Tobacco - General Complaint
request_types.description: Use this service request to report sale of tobacco products or tobacco accessories without the required City of Chicago business license, and to report tobacco violations (i.e., Business selling unstamped or loose cigarettes).

request_types.name: Tobacco - Sale to Minors Complaint
request_types.description: Use this service request to report a business that may be selling tobacco products and/or tobacco accessories to children under 18 years of age.

request_types.name: Traffic Signal Out Complaint
request_types.description: Report traffic signals and/or pedestrian crosswalk signals that are not working or are flashing.

request_types.name: Transportation Assistance – Disabilities
request_types.description: This service request should be used to request assistance obtaining or replacing a Free Ride Card, Reduced Fare Card or paratransit transportation service. This program is only available to people 59 years of age and under.

request_types.name: Tree Debris Clean-Up Request
request_types.description: Use this service request to request a pick-up of a pile of branches or bushes. The branches/bushes must be neatly stacked in the alley or City parkway near the curb. Blocking a street, sidewalk of alleyway may result in a sanitation code ticket being issued. Certain questions must be answered to complete this request: e.g., is the amount larger than a desk and where is the debris located. The Department of Streets and Sanitation, Bureau of Forestry picks up large piles of branches. Use this service request for all Debris Removal requests.

request_types.name: Tree Emergency
request_types.description: Use this service request to report a tree emergency, such as a parkway tree blocking the street, sidewalk, or alley, and/or a parkway tree on a car, house, or garage.

request_types.name: Tree Planting Request
request_types.description: Requests to plant a tree on the City parkway in front of your house are done through this service request. The parkway is the space between the curb and the city sidewalk. Certain answers are required to enter a work order: the address you want a tree planted at, how many trees you want planted, and whether a tree has been planted at this address recently. The Department of Streets and Sanitation, Bureau of Forestry oversees tree planting for the City of Chicago.

request_types.name: Tree Removal Inspection
request_types.description: A City inspector will check trees on the public way to determine if they are dead or diseased. The inspector will order the removal of dead or dangerous trees. If a tree is not dead or diseased the City will not remove it. Certain answers are required to enter a work order to request removal of a tree from city property: the address at which the tree is located and the location of the tree to be inspected (parkway near the curb, in alley or City-owned vacant lot etc.).

request_types.name: Utility/Energy Assistance - Disabilities
request_types.description: This service request should be used if the gas, electricity, and/or water has been or will be disconnected for a person with a disability. This program is only available to people 59 years of age and under. The Mayor's Office for People with Disabilities does not provide monetary assistance.

request_types.name: Vacant/Abandoned Building Complaint
request_types.description: Use this service request to report an abandoned building in your neighborhood. Please call 311 directly to report any building that is in danger of collapse or poses any other hazard that may cause imminent danger to nearby tenants or the public.

request_types.name: Viaduct Light Out Complaint
request_types.description: Report lights located under viaducts that are not working or are damaged.

request_types.name: Wage Complaint
request_types.description: Use this service request to submit a complaint regarding minimum wage and/or wage theft violations from any employee that works two or more hours within any two week period.

request_types.name: Water in Basement Complaint
request_types.description: Report a backup of water in your home or business under this service request. Certain questions need to be answered to dispatch a sewer crew: the address location, whether the water is dirty or clean, where the water is coming from (floor drain, toilet, shower etc.), how many inches of water have backed up and whether this is a basement, crawl space or ground level. Do not use this service request to report water that has entered your basement through the windows.

request_types.name: Water Lead Test Kit Request
request_types.description: This service request is used to request a free lead test kit mailed to a residential home in the City of Chicago. The kit contains instructions, sample bottles, and other materials for collecting drinking water samples for lead analysis. Kits are mailed to residents on a first-come, first-served basis, and large increases in demand for kits may impact time of delivery. After sample collection, residents will schedule a time for the kit to be picked up and delivered to the Department of Water Management for intake and analysis.

request_types.name: Water Lead Test Visit Request
request_types.description: This service request is used to request an appointment to have water samples for lead analysis collected at a residential home in the City of Chicago. A technician will require entry to the residential home, and samples will be collected out of the kitchen or bathroom tap. Appointments must be scheduled after a period of at least 6 hours of not using the water in the whole home and typically occur in the morning. The samples will be returned to the Department of Water Management for intake and analysis. If residents would like to collect the samples themselves instead of a technician, they may use the Water Lead Test Kit service request to request a kit in the mail.

request_types.name: Water On Street Complaint
request_types.description: This service request is used to report water that remains on the street following a rain storm. Certain questions need to be answered to dispatch a sewer crew: the address of the location, the location of the water (middle of street, curb line, alley etc.) Additional information that is helpful includes whether water is bubbling up in the street, and from where. Noting whether any construction has been done in the street lately, and by whom, can also help.

request_types.name: Water Quality Concern
request_types.description: This service request is used to report a water quality concern in drinking water within the City of Chicago. If residents are interested in testing the drinking water for lead, please use the Water Lead Test Kit or Water Lead Test Visit service requests. Engineers from the Division of Water Quality typically respond to concerns within 1 to 2 business days. If water samples are collected in response to the concern, initial results are received in 24 hours, and final results are received in up to 4 weeks.

request_types.name: Weed Removal Request
request_types.description: High weeds can be cut and removed from the public way by using this service request. Certain answers are required to report high weeds: the address and the location(vacant lot, alley etc.) of the overgrown weeds. The Department of Streets and Sanitation, Bureau of Sanitation cuts weeds for the City of Chicago.

request_types.name: Wire Basket Request
request_types.description: Use this service request for requesting a wire basket on a corner in front of a business or store front.
